# MFJ Grant Strategies

> Strategic federal grants management, compliance, and consulting for tribal
> nations, municipalities, state agencies, and nonprofits. Founded by
> Matthew F. Johnston, who has worked every side of the federal funding
> table: funder (USAID), research recipient (VCU), tribal-government
> recipient (Oneida Indian Nation), and independent federal grant reviewer.

## About
- [MFJ Grant Strategies](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/): Firm overview, founder background, services, and process.

## Founder
- [Matthew F. Johnston](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/about-matt.html), Founder & Principal. Former USAID grants officer (funder side), research-administration experience at VCU College of Engineering (R1 recipient), grants role with the Oneida Indian Nation (tribal recipient), and independent federal grant reviewer. Roughly $425M in federal funding administered or supported across 13 federal agencies over that career; these are portfolios administered, not funds personally awarded or raised. The founder page states precisely what each figure means. Deep fluency in 2 CFR 200 (Uniform Guidance).

## Services
- [Federal Grants Management](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/federal-grants-management.html): Post-award administration from award setup to closeout.
- [2 CFR 200 Compliance Consulting](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/2-cfr-200-compliance.html): Uniform Guidance compliance, internal controls, and Single Audit readiness.
- [Tribal Grant Consulting](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/tribal-grant-consulting.html): Federal funding strategy, 638 contracting, and compliance for tribal governments.
- [USAID & Federal Assistance Award Management](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/usaid-grant-management.html): Award management for NGOs and development organizations, informed by funder-side USAID experience.
- [Federal Grant Readiness Assessments](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/grant-readiness-assessments.html): An honest read on capacity, financial health, and documentation before applying.
- [Municipal Grant Consulting](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/municipal-grant-consulting.html): Cross-agency federal funding strategy and administration for cities and counties.
- [Higher Education & Research Grants Management](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/higher-education-grants-management.html): Sponsored programs and research administration for universities and research institutions.
- [Nonprofit & International NGO Grants Management](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/nonprofit-ngo-grants-management.html): Award administration, compliance, and diversified funding strategy for nonprofits and NGOs.
- [Federal Funding Strategy](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/federal-funding-strategy.html): Opportunity identification and cross-agency portfolio development.
- [Fractional Grants Department](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/fractional-grants-department.html): An outsourced, part-time grants office on a monthly retainer, covering research, proposals, administration, compliance, reporting, and training. Never contingency-based.
- Post-award grant administration, grant portfolio management, and grant strategy and development.

## Who We Serve
- Tribal nations and tribally-owned organizations
- Municipal, county, and state governments
- Nonprofit organizations
- Healthcare organizations
- Housing & community development

## Expertise
- 2 CFR 200 (Uniform Guidance) compliance and audit readiness
- Post-award administration: financial reporting, procurement, cost share, subrecipient monitoring, closeout
- Federal funding across HUD, DOT, DOJ, USDA, EPA, HHS/HRSA/CMS, BIA, IHS
- Grant portfolio management and institutional capacity building

## Location
- Based in Richmond, Virginia. Serving clients nationwide.

## Tools & Examples
- [Single Audit Readiness Scorecard](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/single-audit-readiness-scorecard.html): Free twelve-question self-assessment of internal controls against the areas a Single Audit under 2 CFR 200 Subpart F examines. Illustrative; not an audit.

## Guides & Resources
- [MFJ Grants Intelligence](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/resources.html): Professional guides, checklists, and reference manuals on federal grants management and 2 CFR 200 compliance (launching soon).
- [Federal Grants Knowledge Center](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/knowledge-center.html): Educational articles and original analysis on 2 CFR 200, funding strategy, tribal funding, administration, compliance, and institutional capacity (new articles in development).
